claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer.
claims.evidence: Witness report describes an industrial metal gearbox/gearbox-like housing with cooling fins and a circular front opening, consistent with a speed reducer/gear motor component.

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model and gear ratio (affects compatibility and value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label (brand, model, gear ratio, serial number) or any readable markings on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded/unknown speed reducer with unknown ratio and compatibility.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be worn, seized, or noisy).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing it running under power (or a test report) plus a sound/vibration check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested / potentially faulty.

risks.risk: Possible oil/grease issues or leaks (common failure point in reducers).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the oil fill/drain areas and seals, and the base plate for any wetness or residue; include a wipe-and-check clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown lubrication/leak status.

risks.risk: Shaft wear/play and keyway condition (affects usability and coupling fit).
risks.proof: A clip showing the shaft movement/play (manual wiggle) and close-up of the shaft end/keyway with a ruler/caliper for size.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (coupling, motor, mounting hardware, cover plates) or incomplete assembly.
risks.proof: A full set photo of everything included laid out, plus photos of all ports/openings and whether any covers are missing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/only the shown unit.

risks.risk: Compatibility uncertainty: input/output type, mounting pattern, and coupling interface.
risks.proof: Photos showing both sides (motor/input side and output side), including mounting face and any coupling/shaft interface; include measurements of bolt pattern.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the nameplate/label with brand, model, gear ratio, and serial number.
Send a short video showing the reducer running (or a test confirmation) and demonstrate smooth operation.
Send close-ups of seals, oil fill/drain points, and the base plate to confirm no leaks/residue.
Send close-ups of the output shaft end/keyway and a measurement of shaft diameter/length.
Send photos of both input and output sides showing coupling/interface and mounting bolt pattern.
Confirm what is included (only the reducer vs reducer + motor + coupling + mounting accessories) with a full contents photo.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a gearbox/speed reducer housing, but key pricing drivers (model/ratio, working condition, leaks, shaft condition, and completeness) are not shown. Without at least one proof shot (nameplate and/or running/test evidence), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
